exercise.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
library_steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Push the rope down to your thighs, pulling the ends apart at the bottom.
Let it rise slowly to chest height, elbows fixed at your sides.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing facing a high pulley with a slight forward lean, a rope held in both fists (thumbs up); elbows stay pinned by the sides while they straighten from ~95 deg (hands at the lower chest) to straight (hands beside the thighs, rope ends pulled apart). Triceps does the work.

setup.target: High pulley (top of the column, ~2 m), rope attachment.
setup.why: Library step; S1 used a cable machine for the arm-by-the-side extension.

setup.target: Standing ~0.5 m from the column, feet hip-width, trunk leaning slightly forward.
setup.why: Keeps the upper arm by the side while the cable pulls from above.

setup.target: Neutral (palms facing each other), one rope end in each fist, knob below the little finger.
setup.why: Library step: hold an end in each hand.

movement.measure: upper arm from the torso side line

muscles.emg: All three heads active and fatiguing at comparable rates in the push-down (S2); all heads grew after arm-by-the-side cable extensions (S1).
muscles.role: Straightens the elbow; what the exercise is for.
Hold the upper arm still by the side.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arms swing forward as the hands come up.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Library step: elbows fixed at the sides.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Trunk bends far forward to push with the body weight.
mistakes.why_it_matters: The arms, not the body, should move the load.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250.
sources.what_it_gave: Cable-machine elbow extensions (90-0 deg) with the arm overhead vs by the side (neutral, pushdown-like), 12 weeks: all three triceps heads grew in both; the long head grew ~1.5x more overhead.

sources.citation: Hussain J, Sundaraj K, Subramaniam ID, Lam CK. 2020. Muscle fatigue in the three heads of triceps brachii during intensity and speed variations of triceps push-down exercise. Front Physiol 11:112.
sources.what_it_gave: Cable triceps push-down to failure, sEMG of the long, lateral and medial heads: all three heads work and fatigue at comparable rates.

clip_check.check: Start: elbow ~95, hands at lower-chest height
End: arms straight, hands beside the thighs, rope ends apart
Upper arms by the sides in both pictures
Both fists closed on the rope; the rope runs from the fists to the cable
Triceps the only red, strong in both pictures
